programme.title: Kingdom of The Blue Whale
programme.desc: Maailman johtavat sinivalaiden tutkijat lähtevät National Geographic Societyn tukemina vallankumoukselliselle tehtävälle: he etsivät, tunnistavat ja merkitsevät Kalifornian sinivalaita ja hyödyntävät DNA-näytteitä valaiden sukupuolen määrittämisessä. Sen jälkeen he liittyvät näiden valtavien eläinten muuttomatkalle niiden kerääntyessä Costa Rica Domeen. Asiantuntijat havainnoivat valaiden pariutumisrituaaleja krillimassojen ja virtausten keskellä 800 kilometrin päässä Costa Rican rannikolta. He toivovat löytävänsä ja tallentavansa sinivalastutkimuksen Graalin maljan eli meren suurimman nisäkkään parittelu- ja poikimispaikan meressä.

programme.title: Jääkarhujen valtakunta
programme.desc: Dennis otsib Manitoba metsikusest jääkarukoobast, lootes jäädvustada karupoja esimesed hetked elust looduses.

programme.title: Jääkarhujen valtakunta
programme.desc: Dennis seuraa emokarhua ja kahta poikasta niiden valmistautuessa astumaan vaaralliselle jäälle ja kohtaamaan entistäkin suurempia haasteita.

programme.title: Villi Arabia
programme.desc: Hämmästyttävällä matkalla Omanin muinaisiin meriin ja aavikoihin todistamme, miten merkilliset eläimet, kuten sarvikyykäärmeet ja hännänheiluttajaliskot, selviytyvät raaoissa aavikkomaisemissa. Myöhemmin suuntaamme villiin rannikkoon, jossa kilpikonnat, selkärankaiset delfiinit ja valaat hallitsevat Arabianmeren aaltojen alla.

programme.title: Espanjan rannikkovartiosto
programme.desc: Kun rannikkovartiosto on kintereillä, huumeiden salakuljettajat heittävät laittoman lastinsa veteen välttääkseen kiinni jäämisen. Vedenalaisen erikoisyksikön on muutettava huumeoperaatiota koskevia suunnitelmiaan hukkumiskuoleman estämiseksi. Laiton kalastusalus piilottelee pimeässä ja koettaa välttää kiinnijäämistä.

programme.title: Alaskan lentopelastajat
programme.desc: Lentokoneet ovat Alaskassa ehdottomia, sillä niillä voi toimittaa elintärkeitä tarvikkeita ja pelastaa kadonneita tai loukkaantuneita alueilla, joille tiet eivät vie. Rankat säät ja äärimmäinen maasto luovat maan vaarallisimmat ilmailuolosuhteet, joita lentäjien on kestettävä saadakseen työnsä hoidettua kaikin keinoin. Kolmiosaisessa erikoisohjelmassa tutustutaan vaaralliseen ammattiin ja hurjapäiden ottamiin riskeihin.

programme.title: Antarktis
programme.desc: Talven lähestyessä kenttätiimit vievät kauden tutkimuksiaan päätökseen. Viimeinen tilaisuus kerätä tietoa jäätyneeltä mantereelta. Kun suurin osa väestä valmistautuu jo lähtöön, on konttilaiva tuomassa ruokaa ja välineistöä huoltotiimille, joka jää paikalle pitkän, pimeän ja hyytävän talven ajaksi.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. The City of Durban and Durban Stars have brought the heat to the beautiful beachfront with the Surfing South Africa sanctioned Pro Surf Tour competition. Over 3 three days, the top 100 surfers gather in the South African city to participate in the hottest surfing competition of the African country.You can expect high-level competition with waves that are over 2-3 foot in Durban Extravaganza. Competing at the Bay of Plenty, surfers will surely dive in for plenty of action. A fanta-SEA for surf lovers!

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup
programme.desc: Welcome back to this edition of the Atlantic Cup. It is time for the third and final leg of the competition, the inshore series. Dragon and Gryphon Solo 2 are tied for, and teams have added 4 extra crew, allowing them to push their boats around the tight courses in Naragannset Bay. Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Frozen Waterfalls - Icekayaking
programme.desc: Frozen Waterfalls - Icekayaking

programme.title: Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec
programme.desc: Rowing through icy currents in the cold is not for the faint of heart. However, every year competitors jump into their canoes to race in the Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec. The Canoe Race is a legendary competition that has been held since the Carnival's first edition. When the Québec Winter Carnival returned in 1955, ice canoe racing became once again an important annual event, and is now awaited by many in the Canadian city.Each year, several courageous teams compete in extremely freezing conditions a tumultuous ride along the St. Lawrence River between Quebec City and Levis. Find out which team will win against the cold and icy Canadian conditions!

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. The level of expectation and the anticipation was extremely high and both the organizers and the participants proved that it was worth waiting for the comeback. Let’s remember the most notable moments of what was a fascinating season full of top-level sailing battles in some crystal clear blue waters.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Rab has a rich history and has been inhabited by numerous great personalities. The Romans named this place Felix Arba or Lucky, which actually means Happy island. With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We begin our journey inside Sail-Ho at the most beautiful and magical old city: Dubrovnik. Home to many famous TV series due to its historical and beautiful landscape, we are ready to sail around the Elafiti islands and introduce you to the top quality wines of Pelješac peninsula.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to Greece and the beautiful island of Symi in the middle of the Aegean Sea. In this episode we will witness the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec
programme.desc: Rowing through icy currents in the cold is not for the faint of heart. However, every year competitors jump into their canoes to race in the Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec. The Canoe Race is a legendary competition that has been held since the Carnival's first edition. When the Québec Winter Carnival returned in 1955, ice canoe racing became once again an important annual event, and is now awaited by many in the Canadian city.Each year, several courageous teams compete in extremely freezing conditions a tumultuous ride along the St. Lawrence River between Quebec City and Levis. Find out which team will win against the cold and icy Canadian conditions!

programme.title: 3 Days
programme.desc: Telegram: SkarlavaIn June 2015 something that changed the history of surfing took place in Nias. For three epic days on the 28th, 29th and 30th some of the heaviest barrels on the planet exploded onto the Indonesian reef. This has resulted in 3 days of surfing madness in Nias, Indonesia as the bravest world surfers dive into the water to battle and catch some of the biggest waves.Featuring world known surfers Luke Dillon, Dave Rastovich, Courtney Conlogue, Anthony Walsh, Damien Healey, Matt Bronley, Justin Bu'ulolo, Alex Bu'ulolo, Jim Burgin, Antoni Dachi, Skeet Durham, Philips, Matt Younis, Rodrigo Sino Leonardo Kessa and more...Don’t miss out on 3 days of pumping waves and heavy barrels that will mesmerise you on Nautical Channel.

Any mistake could be the difference between first and last. Who will become the winner in this edition?

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. The level of expectation and the anticipation was extremely high and both the organizers and the participants proved that it was worth waiting for the comeback. Let’s remember the most notable moments of what was a fascinating season full of top-level sailing battles in some crystal clear blue waters.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. The City of Durban and Durban Stars have brought the heat to the beautiful beachfront with the Surfing South Africa sanctioned Pro Surf Tour competition. Over 3 three days, the top 100 surfers gather in the South African city to participate in the hottest surfing competition of the African country.You can expect high-level competition with waves that are over 2-3 foot in Durban Extravaganza. Competing at the Bay of Plenty, surfers will surely dive in for plenty of action. A fanta-SEA for surf lovers!

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: The Dangerous Waters crewmembers will ride an epic adventure like no other on their JetSki. Their world-first adventure is plagued with wildlife, wicked waters, tropical storms and new unknown challenges they will have to overcome. As the conditions worsen, crewmembers are forced to drastically take decisions in an environment where not all will get to their final destination.Become part of the crew as they battle the elements on their JetSkis, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Jet Ski World Series
programme.desc: Put your helmets on because we are getting started with the Jet Ski World Series! Delivering whooping speeds of 100km/hr in under 3.8 seconds and with 500 horsepower, riders need to be sharp to turn 30 degrees at 140 km/h, putting the 'Jet' in Jet Ski. Wearing no protective body, grappling with the waves and fighting out with gravity, the riders that dare challenge this competition are some of the most corageous athletes in the world. Are you going to miss out? Tune up to the latest edition of the Jet Ski World Series!

programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to Greece and the beautiful island of Symi in the middle of the Aegean Sea. Symi is part of the Dodecanese island chain, located about forty-one kilometers northwest of Rhodes, featuring fifty-eight-point one square kilometers of mountainous terrain. In this episode we will witness the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio.

programme.title: Surf Series: South Africa
programme.desc: The Vic Bay Classic takes place in the winter months so expect the biggest swells and highest quality of surfing. Watch former CT contender fight for the win as the crowd cheers their local hero. The fight for the mens series winner gets even closer at this final event. Who will claim victory and take the overall series winnings in the season finale of the City Surf Series?

programme.title: Kädet aivoja aktivoimassa
programme.desc: Tiesitkö, että käsien ja huulien alue on vahvasti edustettuna aivokuorella? Käsien ja huulien yhdistelmäliikkeet aktivoivat aivoja tehokkaasti. Aistit ovat portti muistoihin ja eri aistien käyttötukee aivojen toimintaa. Tässä jaksossa aktivoimme aivoja käsien, suun alueen ja aistien kautta. Tervetuloa mukaan. Harjoitukset sopivat kaikille katsojille.

programme.title: Seisomafysio - Kokovartalojumppa seisten: Liikkuvuus ja koordinaatio
programme.desc: Nyt treenataan koko kroppaa. Kyseinen harjoituskerta sisältää kokonaisvaltaista kehon liikkuvuuden ja koordinaation parantamista. Näiden osa-alueiden harjoitteet auttavat pitämään toimintakykyä yllä mahdollisimman pitkään. Voit halutessasi muokata liikkeitä istuma-asennossa tehtäviksi.

programme.title: Yhteislauluja Raatihuoneella
programme.desc: Tangokuningatar Heta Halonen toimii esilaulajana ja Visa Luttinen säestää pianolla. Tule mukaan laulamaan! Lauluina Hymyhuulet, Liian vähän aikaa, Tuuli tuo, tuuli vie, Lauanta-ilta, Kissa vieköön, Haaveissa vainko oot mun, Lazzarella ja 15. Yö.

programme.title: Turvallisesti netissä - Arjen tietoturva
programme.desc: Ohjelmasarjassa kerromme internetin turvallisesta käytöstä ja opimme siitä yhdessä vieraiden kokemuksien kautta. Tässä jaksossa kuulemme, mitä tietoturva oikein tarkoittaa ja miksi se koskee meitä kaikkia. Ohjelman juontajana ja ilmiöistä kertomassa on tietoturva-asiantuntija Samuli Könönen Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskuksesta. Tervetuloa oppimaan arjen tietoturvasta.

programme.title: Vahvuusvartti
programme.desc: Luonteenvahvuuksien käyttäminen innostaa, voimaannuttaa ja tuo myönteisiä tunteita. Mutta mistä löydän niitä? Miten otan ne käyttööni? Ikäinstituutin Vahvuusvartissa esitellään erilaisia tapoja omien vahvuuksien tunnistamiseen ja hyödyntämiseen.

programme.title: Koordinaatio ja istumatasapaino
programme.desc: Koordinaation sekä istumatasapainon kehittäminen matalan kynnyksen liikkeillä. Tuokiossa käännetään katsetta eri suuntiin, tehdään painonsiirtoa istuen, sekä kehitetään koordinaatiota käsien ja jalkojen aivoja virkistävillä harjoitteilla.

programme.title: Laiva on lastattu aivopähkinöillä
programme.desc: Pohditaan yhdessä erilaisia keinoja, miten voi virkistää ajattelua ja tehdä aivojumppaa. Pelataan Laiva on lastattu -peliä. Esiintyjät: geronomiopiskelija Eija Marttila sosionomiopiskelija Sakari Rantala Eläkeläiset Aulikki Järvi ja Rae-Marja Vataja lehtori Hanna Raitakari

programme.title: Seisomafysio - Hyvinvointia selälle
programme.desc: Nyt hoidetaan selkää kuntoon liikkumisen avulla. Harjoituksessa keskitytään selän alueeseen. Tavoitteena on vetreyttää selkää, lisätä sen liikkuvuutta, sekä parantaa tukilihasten toimintaa selän ja keskivartalon alueella. Harjoitukset on laadittu ensisijaisesti seisoen tehtäviksi, mutta pystyt osallistumaan myös istuma-asennossa.

programme.title: Kesämuistoni

Attraverso un intreccio di materiali d'archivio, testimonianze inedite di artisti e una messa in scena teatrale e surreale, il documentario mette in luce la straordinaria parabola artistica e umana di uno dei comici più amati dal pubblico italiano: Lino Banfi, simbolo di un'Italia popolare, generosa e autoironica. programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: Naomi will für Paco da sein, kann aber nicht riskieren, dass ihre Geheimmission vor Alexander auffliegt. Also schreitet Britta zur Tat ... Nach einem Schock hält Dana die Familie zusammen und dringt selbst zum wütenden Ferhat durch. Aber ist sie wirklich so selbstlos, wie sie tut? Ute und Benedikt wollen Patrizia und Jori beistehen. Falls diese ihre Hilfe zulassen können ...

programme.title: Explosiv - Das Magazin
programme.desc: Aktuell, mitreißend und gefährlich ehrlich - das ist Deutschlands beliebtestes tägliches Boulevard-Magazin. Explosiv präsentiert die Geschichten, die Deutschland bewegen und regelmäßig für öffentliche Diskussionen sorgen. Das RTL-Magazin knüpft immer dort an, wo die Geschichten der Menschen hinter den News beginnen und beweist, dass Boulevard deutlich mehr ist als nur Sensationsjournalismus.

programme.title: Exclusiv - Das Starmagazin
programme.desc: Wo ein roter Teppich ausgerollt wird, ist Exclusiv nicht weit. Täglich liefert Deutschlands erfolgreichstes Starmagazin die aktuellsten Promi-News, verrät die heißesten Gerüchte und gibt Einblicke in das Leben der angesagtesten Celebrities dieser Welt. Von Hollywood bis Berlin, von royalen Hochzeiten bis zu privaten Glücksmomenten - Exclusiv berichtet zuverlässig und aktuell aus der Welt der Stars und Sternchen.

programme.title: RTL Aktuell
programme.desc: Im Vordergrund der Hauptnachrichtensendung RTL Aktuell stehen die Themen, die wirklich relevant für die Zuschauer sind. Welche Auswirkungen haben politische Entscheidungen, wirtschaftliche Entwicklungen, soziale Trends und Innovationen wie zum Beispiel medizinische Neuerungen auf ihr Leben? Diese an den unmittelbaren Interessen der Zuschauer orientierten Fragen stehen konsequent im Mittelpunkt der Nachrichtenvermittlung bei RTL Aktuell.

programme.title: Alles was zählt
programme.desc: Mit seinem Verhalten stößt Dragan jemanden vor den Kopf, der ihm eigentlich eine wichtige Nachricht übermitteln möchte. Elias' und Joanas Comeback steht durch Elias' Lampenfieber auf dem Spiel. Doch die eigentliche Bedrohung kommt aus einer ganz anderen Richtung. Daniela ist gewillt, sich mehr Ruhe zu gönnen, bis sie erkennt, dass sie eine wichtige Veranstaltung im Restaurant vergessen hat.

programme.title: Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten
programme.desc: Yvonne hadert mit der Entscheidung, den Kontakt zu Gerner endgültig zu kappen. Nihat versucht, sich von Matilda abzulenken, wird jedoch in seinem Vorhaben gestoppt. Stattdessen muss er in die Rolle ihres Verlobten schlüpfen.

programme.title: Die Bachelors
programme.desc: Die letzte Rose ist zum Greifen nah: Nach emotionalen Wochen voller Hoffnung, Zweifel und großer Gefühle steht die wichtigste Entscheidung der Liebesreise bevor. Bei den letzten Dates wird gelacht, geweint und über die gemeinsame Zukunft gesprochen, bevor sich im großen Finale entscheidet, wer die letzte Rose bekommen soll. Danach spricht Frauke Ludowig mit den Kandidat:innen über die Zeit nach dem Finale und enthüllt, was seitdem passiert ist.

programme.title: Es war Mord!
programme.desc: Christin Rexin stirbt mit 21 Jahren - nach drei gescheiterten Mordversuchen! Sabines Tod an einer Kellertreppe wirft Fragen auf, als ein Medikament im Notfallkoffer ihres Mannes fehlt. Ermittlungen decken schockierende Details auf.

programme.title: RTL Nachtjournal
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt des Nachrichtenjournals RTL Nachtjournal steht die vertiefende aktuelle Berichterstattung. Das Thema des Tages wird regelmäßig durch kritische Interviews mit Verantwortlichen aus Politik und Wirtschaft beleuchtet.

programme.title: RTL Nachtjournal Spezial
programme.desc: RTL sendet ein Nachtjournal Spezial direkt nach den Spätnachrichten, in dem Interviewgäste aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft ausführlich zu Wort kommen. Die etwa zwanzigminütige Sendung bietet eine vertiefte Analyse aktueller Themen.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Ein Diamantenhändler wurde in einem Parkhaus erschossen. Die Tat wurde von Eugene Walters beobachtet. Er ist jedoch in seiner geistigen Entwicklung auf dem Stand eines Kleinkindes, weshalb man seiner Aussage keine große Beachtung schenkt.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Der Exil-Kubaner und Zigarrenmacher Juan Marco Varon ist brutal gefoltert und ermordet worden. Bei der Tatwaffe handelt es sich um eine 'Chaveta', ein Werkzeug, das zur Herstellung von Zigarren benutzt wird. Die Spur führt zu Marisela Coto und ihrer Organisation 'Freies Kuba'. Unterdessen wird ein weiter Mann erschossen vor einem Geldautomaten gefunden. Er wurde mit einer Winfield niedergestreckt, die als typische Frauenwaffe gilt.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: In den Everglades wurde die Leiche eines Jägers gefunden. Dessen Jagdgefährte gibt zu, mit dem Toten einen Streit ausgetragen zu haben. Dann wird die Leiche einer Frau entdeckt, die Bissspuren von einem Menschen aufweist.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: Es gelingt Ray, seine Ex-Frau Gloria im letzten Moment aus den Fängen des Killers Nate Haskell zu befreien. Als die von Ray angeforderte Verstärkung eintrifft, finden die Polizisten sowohl Haskell als auch Arvin Thorpe nur noch tot vor.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Während einer Fahrt mit einer Hotel-Tram kommt es zu einer Schießerei, bei der zwei Menschen sterben und mehrere Personen verletzt werden. Ein kleiner Junge war Zeuge des Geschehens und gibt an, dass er einen Alien am Tatort gesehen hat.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Das CSI-Team wird zu einem grausamen Vierfach-Mord gerufen: Die Familie Chambliss, Großmutter, Vater, Mutter und Tochter Fiona wurden grausam abgeschlachtet. Schnell gibt es einen ersten Verdächtigen: Eine Blutspur vom Tatort führt zu dem jungen Pädophilen John Lee, der die Tat auch tatsächlich zugibt. Doch wenig später taucht Leslie Gitig im Polizeirevier auf und behauptet, aus verschmähter Liebe die Morde begangen zu haben. Nachdem ihr Ex-Geliebter, Cal Chambliss, sich wieder seiner Frau zugewandt hat, habe sie sich an ihm gerächt. Tatsächlich verfügt Gitig über spezielle Kenntnisse des Tathergangs, allerdings weist ihre Geschichte an vielen Stellen Ungereimtheiten auf, die sie als alleinige Täterin wiederum ausschliessen...

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Das Date von Nick mit der Nichte von Doc Robbins findet ein jähes Ende: Er entdeckt in einer Skulptur einbetonierte Leichenteile. Schnell findet das herbeigerufene CSI-Team noch weitere Betonbrocken. Die Vorgehensweise entspricht der des Killerpärchens Todd und Gina Sinclair, die vor Jahren mehrere Mädchen gefoltert, vergewaltigt und umgebracht haben. Brisanterweise wurde Gina Sinclair soeben aus dem Gefängnis entlassen. Das letzte Opfer der beiden, Colleen Hughes, konnte damals von der Polizei im letzten Moment befreit werden. D.B. Russell warnt Colleen, dass Gina wieder auf freiem Fuss ist, doch umsonst: Kurze Zeit später ist die junge Frau verschwunden. Sara ist sich sicher, dass Gina ihr vor Jahren abgebrochenes Werk vollenden will.

programme.title: Deutschland am Morgen
programme.desc: Dein Morgen, dein Rhythmus: Deutschland am Morgen von RTL und ntv ist der tägliche Begleiter für alle, die bestens informiert und gut unterhalten in den Tag starten wollen. Von 6 bis 9 Uhr liefert das Nachrichtenmagazin die wichtigsten Themen und ordnet sie verständlich ein. Ob Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport oder Service: Feste Rubriken und spannende Talks sorgen für den richtigen Takt am Morgen.

programme.title: Tässä on elämäsi (16)
programme.desc: Klassinen filmatisointi Eyvind Johnsonin romaanisarjasta, jossa Olof jättää vuonna 1914 kotinsa Norlannissa ja lähtee maailmalle.

programme.title: Amorosa (16)
programme.desc: Draama kirjailija Agnes von Krusenstjernasta, aatelisrouvasta, joka sai aikaan skandaalin kehdatessaan täyttää romaaninsa rakkaudella ja erotiikalla.

programme.title: Kesälesket (12)
programme.desc: Kaksi kundia joilla on hyvin erilaiset taustat ja arvot kohtaavat kuuman kesäviikon aikana Tukholmassa. Heidän vaimonsa ovat matkoilla. Lasse on valmistautunut tyypilliseen poikamiesviikkoon, Gary taas rauhalliseen työviikkoon...

programme.title: Peppi seitsemällä merellä (S)
programme.desc: Eräänä päivänä Peppi saa pullopostia. Hänen isänsä, kapteeni Pitkätossu, on joutunut merirosvojen haaviin, ja nyt hän pyytää vahvaa tytärtään avuksi. Peppi ei epäröi hetkeäkään vaan kääntää kokkansa kohti Etelämerta.

programme.title: Vilken jävla cirkus (12)
programme.desc: Draamakomedia kriisissä olevasta nuoresta Hugosta, joka kaatuu pyörällä ja herää sirkuksessa, joka on täynnä värikkäitä tyyppejä.

programme.title: Kahden kauppa (16)
programme.desc: Lasse on valmistunut toimittajakoulusta, mutta ei löydä töitä. Tyttöjä hänellä sen sijaan riittää. Kun hän tapaa Lenan, hän tietää, että kyse on jostakin vakavammasta. Mutta hänen on vaikea luopua muista tytöistä ja työtä vieroksuvasta elämäntavastaan.

programme.title: Iso paksu isäni (S)
programme.desc: Rolf Lassgårdin Guldbagge-palkittu draama sijoittuu kesään 1959. Ruotsin pölyisillä teillä liikkuu Volvo PV kyydissään 11-vuotias Osvald ja tämän vanhemmat. Isällä on tapansa mukaan suuria suunnitelmia; hän aikoo opettaa kirkkokuorolle uuden messun, pelata jalkapalloa poikansa kanssa ja parantaa kuntoaan juoksemalla traktorin perässä.

programme.title: Maastamuuttajat – Viimeinen kirje Ruotsiin (12)
programme.desc: Vilhelm Mobergin klassikkokirjaan perustuva komea draama talonpoikaisparista, joka jättää 1800-luvun Ruotsin aloittaakseen uuden elämän Amerikassa.

programme.title: Ett öga rött (7)
programme.desc: Oletko tarkastanut kuinka kaikki liittyy yhteen? Osaatko murtaa kaikki koodit? Oletko mahtavin Casanova päällä maan? Oletko ajatussulttaani? Ett öga rött on värikäs tarina joka perustuu löyhästi Jonas Hassen Khemirin menestysromaaniin.

programme.title: Elvira Madigan (12)
programme.desc: Luutnantti Sixten Sparre rakastuu intohimoisesti nuorallatanssijatar Elvira Madiganiin. Hän pakenee armeijasta, ja pariskunta pakenee Tanskaan. Pian todellisuus lyö kasvoille, ja rakkaudenhuumaista kesäidylliä varjostaa kuoleman pelko.

programme.title: Arn - Pohjoinen valtakunta (12)
programme.desc: Saagan toisessa osassa Arn jättää Jerusalemin ja palaa kotiinsa tavatakseen rakkaansa Cecilian. He menevät naimisiin ja perustavat perheen, mutta ajat eivät ole suinkaan vakaat -sota uhkaa puhjeta minä hetkenä hyvänsä.

programme.title: Flykten till framtiden (S)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen aikamatkakomedia, jossa sydänvikainen nuorimies lähtee 70-luvun Tukholmasta metrolla seikkailemaan meidän aikaamme.

programme.title: Uutisreportteri Morgan Pålsson (12)
programme.desc: Epäpätevä ruotsalaistoimittaja valokuvaajineen joutuu ainoana ulkomaalaistiiminä keskelle sotilasvallankaappausta pienessä afrikkalaisessa maassa.

programme.title: Hyvää iltaa, herra Wallenberg (16)
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva draama ruotsalaisesta poliitikosta, joka pelasti II MS:n aikana juutalaisia Budapestista Ruotsiin.

programme.title: Ådalen 31 (12)
programme.desc: Vuonna 1931 Ådalenin tehtaiden savupiipuista ei kohonnut savua. Menossa oli solidaarisuuslakko Marman työntekijöille, joiden tuntipalkkaa työnantaja halusi laskea. Järjestettiin mielenosoitus, jossa sotilaat ampuivat kuoliaiksi viisi mieltään osoittanutta työläistä.Tarina kertoo työläisperheistä, joihin Ådalenin kesän 1931 tapahtumat vaikuttivat. Lakkoon osallistunut työläinen Harald Andersson hänen vaimonsa Karin käyvät kovaa kamppailua köyhyyttä vastaan samalla kun heidän vanhin poikansa, tehtaankonttorista töitä saanut Kjell, vihitään sisään tehtaanjohtajan perheen hienoon maailmaan. Kjell rakastuu johtajan tyttäreen Annaan, ja Anna tulee raskaaksi...

programme.title: Bitchkram (12)
programme.desc: Kristin odottaa malttamattomana ylioppilaaksi pääsyä ja jännittävää elämää New Yorkissa kaukana rasittavasta siskostaan. Paikallinen lehti on luvannut julkaista Kristinin tarinoita kaupungista, joka ei koskaan nuku. Kristin kuitenkin myöhästyy New Yorkin -lennolta ja päättää häpeissään piiloutua maaseudulle merkillisen Andrean kotiin.

programme.title: Kullannuppu (S)
programme.desc: Eva asuu tätiensä ja serkkunsa Beritin kanssa ja odottaa, että hänen äitinsä parantuisi keuhkotaudista. Evaa kuitenkin syrjitään perheessä, ja Berit tekee kaikkensa pysyäkseen huomion keskipisteenä.

programme.title: Omenasota (S)
programme.desc: Moderni satu, jossa skoonelaiset ympäristönsuojelijat laittavat kapuloita rattaisiin sveitsiläiselle kapitalistille.

programme.title: Peppi Pitkätossu karkuteillä (S)
programme.desc: Tommi ja Annika ovat väsyneitä äidin jatkuvaan nalkutukseen, niinpä he päättävät karata kotoa. Ja tottakai Peppi tulee mukaan! Peppi tietää miten koetaan hauskoja seikkailuja. Hän osaa pyöräillä ilman rengasta ja ajaa autoa jaloillaan. Eikä hän myöskään pelkää mitään. Oli sitten kyseessä vesiputouksen laskeminen tynnyrillä alas, tai vihaisen härän kohtaaminen. Ja kun Peppi on täysin elementissään niin silloin hän menee talosta toiseen pelkkää narua pitkin. Suoraan kadun yli, samalla kun puoli kaupunkia katsoo häntä sydän kurkussa.

programme.title: Monica Z (12)
programme.desc: Monica, nuori, kapinallinen pikkukaupungin tyttö on päättänyt menestyä laulajana Tukholman eloisilla jazzklubeilla. Hän aloittaa unelmiensa laulajan uran, jonka aikana upea laulaja/näyttelijä kehittyy jazzin kultaisella aikakaudella.

programme.title: Två killar och en tjej (S)
programme.desc: Thomas, Klasse ja Anna tutustuivat Tukholmassa 60-luvulla. He olivat hyvät ystävät, ja kaikki olivat tähtiä opiskelijarevyyssä. Opintojen jälkeen heidän tiensä kuitenkin erkanivat. 17 vuoden tauon jälkeen he tapaavat, ja tunteet heräävät.

programme.title: Jonain päivänä kaikki tämä on sinun (7)
programme.desc: Menestynyt sarjakuvapiirtäjä Lisa kokoontuu sisaruksineen vanhempiensa maatilalle ensimmäisen kerran yli kymmeneen vuoteen. Vanhemmat haluavat, että vain yksi sisaruksista perii suvun metsän. Mutta onko kukaan heistä halukas muuttamaan takaisin kotiin? Andreas Öhmanin (Avaruudessa ei ole tunteita) ohjaaman draamakomedian tähtinä ovat Karin Franz Körlof, Peter Haber, Suzanne Reuter ja Liv Mjönes.

programme.title: Täältä tullaan tulevaisuus (7)
programme.desc: Kaksi parikymppistä tyttöä tapaa Poliisikoulun pääsykokeissa. Heillä on hyvin erilaiset taustat mutta silti he ovat hyvin samanlaisia. Tiukat pääsykokeet, sotkuiset rakkaussuhteet ja herkät perhesuhteet koettelevat heidän ystävyyttään.

programme.title: Adam ja Eva (12)
programme.desc: Adamilla ja Evalla on erilaisia käsityksiä suhteestaan. Kun Adam viittaa suhteen uudistamisella siihen että heillä on lupa olla uskottomia, koko juttu hankaloituu. Ollako ystäviä, rakastavaisia vai vihollisia...

programme.title: Så olika (7)
programme.desc: Toisessa elokuvassaan kameran takana Helena Bergström tutkii rakkauden kiemuroita tarinassa kahdesta siskoksesta.

programme.title: Stieg Larsson: Mies joka leikki tulella (12)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen dokumenttielokuva Millennium-kirjojen luojasta Stieg Larssonista ja hänen riskialttiista tutkimuksistaan äärioikeistoryhmien parissa.

programme.title: Hypnotisoija (16)
programme.desc: Synkkänä joulukuisena yönä psykiatri Erik Maria Bark herää, kun hänelle soitetaan tukholmalaisesta sairaalasta. Rikosetsivä Joona Linna pyytää häntä auttamaan akuutista traumasta kärsivän tajuttoman potilaan hoitamisessa.

programme.title: 30:e november
programme.desc: Adam kavereineen kuluttaa aikansa ahdistelemalla vihaamiaan maahanmuuttajia. Sitten Adam tapaa perulaisen Julian ja rakastuu silmittömästi. Koska niin Adamin jengi kuin Julian perhe eivät hyväksyisi suhdetta, heidän on pidettävä rakkautensa salassa.

programme.title: Bäst före (7)
programme.desc: Draamakomedia kolmesta vanhasta ystävästä, jotka voittavat rahaa raveissa ja päättävät lähteä Suomen-risteilylle.

programme.title: Komisario Beck tähtäimessä (16)
programme.desc: Komisario Beck tähtäimessä on kaikkein ensimmäinen elokuva komisario Martin Beckistä. Mestariteoksen takana on Bo Widerberg. Martin Beckin roolissa nähdään Carl Gustaf Lindstedt.

programme.title: Päivä päivältä (12)
programme.desc: Kertomus siitä, ettei irtiotto elämässä ole koskaan liian myöhäistä. Demontoitunut Tage sekä Malte ja Rut asuvat vanhainkodissa. Siellä työskentelevät myös hoitaja Katrin ja siivooja Simon. Yhdessä tämä viisikko reissaa matkailuautolla halki Euroopan täyttääkseen vanhan miehen viimeisen toiveen. Ohjaaja: Felix Herngren. Rooleissa: Martina Haag, Sven Wollter, Marianne Mörck, William Spetz, Tomas von Brömssen, Peter Magnusson, Felix Herngren. (Ruotsi, 2022.)

programme.desc: Rantanen ja Numminen hälytetään rauhoittamaan riehaantunut dementikko. Pakistanilaisen postinjakajan ajokortti aiheuttaa epäilyksiä Rovaniemellä.

programme.title: Armin van Buuren - This is Me
programme.desc: An up close and personal registration of the This is me solo shows by Armin that took place in Amsterdam June 22. After a period of reflecting and producing new music during the pandemic, Armin van Buuren returned to the stage in a magnificent way. Unique concert footage combined with an indepth interview and backstage material.

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow And Pete La Roca - The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Andrey Boreyko, Gewandhaus Orchestra Leipzig, Mischa Maisky And Roby Lakatos - Summer Night Music - Love Songs
programme.desc: In Summer Night Music - Love Songs, artists from all over the world contribute their favourite love songs to an unusual and exciting event uniting classical, jazz, and world music. Among the classical musicians are the Gewandhaus Orchestra, cellist Mischa Maisky, and The King’s Singers. Other world stars include jazz vocalist Dee Dee Bridgewater and flamenco cantaora Mayte Martin. The variety of musicians and genres appeals to a wide audience, aiming to create a grand open-air atmosphere that every music lover will remember.

programme.title: Norayr Kartashyan, Grigor Kartashyan, Artur Mkrtumyan And Edgar Petrosyan - Norayr Kartashyan And Menua - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Norayr Kartashyan, is acclaimed as one of Armenia’s finest woodwind masters and composers, an acknowledged virtuoso numerous traditional Armenian instruments. To name a few: the blul and shvi flutes, duduk, the double-reed zurna trumpet, the pku clarinet, and the parkapzuk bagpipe. Kartashyan’s compositions are gently unfolding, delicately intertwined evocations of rural music with a timeless connection to the earth, full of beauty and warmth.

programme.title: Maarten Hogenhuis, Folkert Oosterbeek, Thomas Rolff And Felix Schlarmann - Paradox Live: BRUUT!
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the amazing Dutch jazzband BRUUT led by saxophone player Maarten Hoogenhuis!

programme.title: Roberta Valente, Alexandre Ribeiro, Gian Correa And Henrique Araujo - Panorama do Choro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Panorama de Coro. This ensemble combines jazz and traditional Brazilian music. The resulting music has a festive, almost street-like atmosphere. Panorama de Coro consists of Roberta Valente (pandeiro and percussion), Alexandre Ribeiro (clarinet), Gian Correa (7-string guitar), Henrique Araujo (cavaquinho), João Poleto (flute and tenor saxophone) and Yves Finzetto (pandeiro and percussion).

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz And Victor Lewis - Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Peter Beets, Marius Beets, Anton Goudsmit And Joost van Schaik - Peter Beets Trio And Goudsmit: Tribute to Montgomery
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age. And though music was in their blood, neither parent associated the word “musician” with a career. In this broadcast, Peter Beets teams up with Anton Goudsmit (guitar) in tribute to guitar icon and founding father of modern jazz Wes Montgomery. The two men share a passion for Montgomery's music, his compositions forming the basis for Goudsmit’s energetic and eccentric solos and Beets's virtuoso piano playing. They are backed by a grooving rhythm section featuring Marius Beets (bass) and Joost van Schaik (drums).

programme.title: Olivier Bogé, Géraldine Laurent, Pierrick Pédron And Thomas de Pourquery - Charlie Parker - Bird with Strings Revisited
programme.desc: In the late 1940s, jazz saxophonist Charlie 'Bird' Parker expressed his wish to record with a classical string section rather than his usual jazz quintet. This desire was fulfilled in 1949 and 1950 when he recorded two albums with oboe, harp, string section and a jazz rhythm section, released as 'Charlie Parker with Strings'. Fast forward 70 years, when saxophonists Olivier Bogé, Géraldine Laurent, Pierrick Pédron, Thomas de Pourquery, and Jaleel Shaw follow in the jazz legend's footsteps, revisiting the repertoire of those original albums in this 2019 concert at The Philharmonie de Paris. Bastien Stil conducts Christophe Dal Sasso's new orchestral arrangements in this genre-blending concert, which opens with Dal Sasso’s very own Overture pour cinq saxophones et orchestra.

programme.title: Gottfried von der Goltz - Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Leonard Slatkin And Orchestre National de Lyon - Beethoven - Triple Concerto, Op. 56
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.title: Kinan Azmeh, Rony Barrak, Jonas Burgwinkel And Michel Godard - The Morgenland Festival: Needless to Say
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Enjoy the musical wealth of the All Star Band in this episode of Morgenland Festival. Featuring graduate of the Boston Conservatory and vocalist Dima Oshno, both songs “Dream” and “Mugam” are played by the All Star Band and express a range of moods that vary from peaceful quietude to outbursts of energy.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: AFROJACK, Galantis, Sam Feldt And Lost Frequencies - Mysteryland
programme.desc: With Afrojack, Galantis, Sam Feldt, Lost Frequencies, and many more, the sold-out, two-day event had over 60,000 fans. Mysteryland dates back to 1993 and is now the world’s longest-running electronic music, culture, and art festival in the world. The first international edition of Mysteryland was held in Chile in 2011. In May 2014, Mysteryland made its stateside debut at the site of the legendary 1969 Woodstock Festival.

programme.title: Radio-Sinfonieorchester Stuttgart des SWR And Gianluigi Gelmetti - Mozart - Symphony No. 40, K. 550
programme.desc: Gianluigi Gelmetti conducts the Radio-Sinfonieorchester Stuttgart in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s Symphony No. 40 in G Minor (K. 550), directed for television by Janos Darvas. The work was composed in 1788 and is sometimes referred to as the Great G minor symphony, with the Symphony No. 25 being the Little G minor symphony. The two are the only of Mozart’s 41 symphonies that were written in a minor key. It is arguably the most popular of all of Mozart’s symphonies. The catchy opening melody became one of the most popular ringtones of mobile phones in the 90s. Scholars are not in agreement whether it was popular in Mozart’s own time. The composer performed it a few times and rewrote some parts of the score.

programme.title: Mike Casey - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Martha Argerich And Eliane Reyes - Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, pianists Martha Argerich and Khramouchin’s widow Eliane Reyes perform Maurice Ravel’s Ma mère l'Oye. This five-part suite was written for piano four hands.

programme.title: Tricia Dawn Williams, Ruben Zahra And Atau Tanaka - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Tricia Dawn Williams
programme.desc: Transition is a portrait of the avant-garde piano stretching almost one hundred years. Each piece on the programme breaks new ground as the music navigates through uncharted waters to depict a new profile for the instrument. Transition by Tricia Dawn Williams is a unique experience that transforms the piano recital into an interdisciplinary performance featuring gesture-control technology, video-art, electronic music and extended piano technique. Born in Malta, of Irish and Welsh descent, Tricia Dawn Williams is committed to contemporary music, multimedia and new technologies. Williams is one of the first concert pianists to collaborate with developers and composers internationally on the application of gesture-control technology. As a dedicated promoter of new music, Williams has commissioned, premiered and recorded numerous works. In this concert from the 2019 edition of Classical:NEXT! musicians Tricia Dawn Williams (piano), Ruben Zahra (tech operator) and Atau Tanaka (tech operator) present a diverse programme of self-composed works and pieces by George Crumb and Henry Cowell.

programme.title: Gottfried von der Goltz And Freiburger Barockorchester - Bach - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: During the years when Bach was in the service of the courts of Prince Leopold in Köthen, he had his own orchestra and was contracted to compose a great deal of instrumental music. This gave him an opportunity to try new techniques and to develop his own instrumental style. The six Brandenburg Concertos belongs to these masterpieces which he composed for a small ensemble . The joyously infectious performance of these masterpieces by the Freiburg Baroque Orchestra demonstrates both the pleasure and the highest professional standard that can be reached with period instruments. Their decision to perform without a conductor is therefore quite deliberate, reviving a tradition practised right back in the 18th century.

programme.title: Count Basie, Snooky Young, Frank Wess And Joe Williams - Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman. His instrument was his band, which was considered the epitome of swing and deeply influenced jazz. In this 1961 concert recording, Count Basie takes the stage in Charleroi.

programme.title: Ed Harcourt, Carl Barât And Peter Doherty - Sgt. Pepper Tribute at Philharmonie de Paris 2017
programme.desc: Celebrated as one of the most influential albums of all times, The Beatles' 1967 Sgt. Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band marked its time and inspired generations of artists. While the album was purely a recording studio product, Beatles’ fans continue to be frustrated by not hearing it live. British musician and composer Ed Harcourt, author of six highly acclaimed albums and collaborator of vocalists Marianne Faithfull, Patti Smith, and trumpeter Erik Truffaz, gathered a supergroup for this occasion with top artists from the British independent rock scene. Join Ed Harcourt and members of The Libertines, Supergrass, The Coral, the Beta Band, and Primal Scream for this special tribute.

programme.title: Ntjam Rosie, Rolf Delfos, Bart Wirtz And Mete Erker - Artvark Saxophone Quartet And Ntjam Rosie: Homelands
programme.desc: Homelands is a collaboration between Artvark Saxophone Quartet and Cameroonian-Dutch singer Ntjam Rosie. The music is inspired by both traditional and modern music from Ntjam’s home country Cameroon, (Manu Dibango and Richard Bona) as well as by an Afro-European blend of soul, jazz, gospel and world music. Using unorthodox sounds as the basis of their compositions, Artvark continues to be radical, experimenting with alternative ways of playing the sax. For this project, they explore the world of electronics and effects to create new sounds. Ntjam’s role is divers. She is the quartet’s fifth instrument, recites spoken word, plays (vocal) percussion, forms duos or trios with the saxophones and accompanies the quartet on her guitar. She performs texts in English as well as in French, one of Cameroon’s official languages, and sings in Bulu, her mother tongue.

programme.title: Arthur Wagenaar - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Close Call
programme.desc: In Close Call your smartphone is a musical instrument. And you are not just an audience member, but a musician in a crazy band with three drummers! Arthur Wagenaar is a Dutch composer and musician. He has a deep love for rock bands, theatre, opera and classical music, and his music is usually a mixture of all of this. He also loves to invent his own instruments, mechanical or electronic, such as the “rampaphone,” a string instrument nine meters in length, the “kleurwerper,” played by juggling, and of course the Close Call Live app. In this performance from Classical:NEXT! in Rotterdam, he is supported by Joep Hendrickx, Tjalling Schrik, Marijn Korff de Gidts, Boy van Ooijen, Dodó Kis, Sarah Jeffery, Lotte Pen, Matthias Konrad, and Axel Schappert.

programme.title: David Grimal And Les Dissonances - Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto’. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. It is the third and final movement that gives Concerto No. 5 its nickname, the ‘Turkish Concerto’. This movement features a striking middle section of ‘Turkish music’, which the composer achieves not only by changing the meter, and the mode to minor, but also by letting the cellos and basses play col legno - creating a percussive sound with the wood of their bow. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Mark Perna - Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Kenny Barron - Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity.

programme.title: Richard Easley, Thornel Schwartz And Jimmy McGriff - Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres. His sound - deep, down-to-earth grooves drenched in blues and gospel feeling - made him popular with RAndB audiences. This 1965 performance is part of the Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Paolo Belloli, Francesco Attesti And Italian OIDA Orchestra - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Rita Reys - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Hilary Hahn - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Andrea Buccarella - Naples, City of Keyboards - Gaetano Greco
programme.desc: Before Porpora, Scarlatti and Pergolesi ruled the Neapolitan music scene there was Gaetano Greco, one of the finest music teachers and composers of his day. Andrea Buccarella, a young harpsichordist from Rome (also performing in the Festival with his Abchordis Ensemble), pairs Greco’s most beautiful toccatas and famous Ballo di Mantua with works by his pupil Durante, who with his ‘quattro stagioni’ explores every nook and cranny of the keyboard.

programme.title: Mahmundi - MPB Sessions - Mahmundi
programme.desc: Marcela Vale, known professionally as Mahmundi, is a singer, songwriter, and music producer from Rio de Janeiro. A Latin Grammy nominee, she is recognized for her originality and authenticity in the contemporary Brazilian music scene. Her work, spanning electronic music, indie, and lo-fi with 1980s influences, is defined by poetic and reflective lyrics. In addition to her solo career, Mahmundi is also active as a producer and instrumentalist. How do contemporary artists reinterpret tradition and create new forms of expression within MPB? Da Pá Virada Sessions' MPB Series investigates this question. Hosted by Dani Gurgel, this episode features a live performance and thought-provoking conversation with Mahmundi, exploring her unique fusion of styles and inviting audiences to discover the richness of modern Brazilian music. Continue your journey into the rich world of contemporary Brazilian popular music with Stingray DJAZZ.

programme.title: Ludwig van Beethoven - Beethoven’s Hair
programme.desc: Beethoven's Hair traces the unlikely journey of a lock of hair cut from Ludwig van Beethoven's corpse, and unravels the mystery of the composer’s tortured life and death. The film begins in modern times, when some Beethoven enthusiasts purchase the hair at a Sotheby's auction. The story then investigates the lock's previous owners. Eventually, science reveals Beethoven's “medical secret”. Set to a lush score of some of Beethoven's most glorious music, the film explores the world of forensic testing, throwing into sharp relief the romance of 19th-century Vienna and the horrors of 20th-century Nazi Germany. Directed by Larry Weinstein.

programme.title: Rob Thorne - Rob Thorne Toi Puo - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, composer/performer/anthropologist Rob Thorne, is a diverse explorer in the newly revived evolution of taonga puoro, traditional Māori instruments, fusing these ancient voices with modern sounds and technology. He creates ethereal and immersive site-specific works as well as contemporary chamber music, born out of in-depth research and respect for tradition.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806. Its first performance was at a private concert in Vienna in March 1807. With its lightweight and sunny character, Symphony No. 4 pales in comparison with its revolutionary predecessor and successor. Jordan’s concert was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Amilton Godoy - Amilton Godoy - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Amilton Godoy. He is not only a well-known soloist in his homeland Brazil, but he is also considered one of the world's greatest pianists today, regularly guesting with international top orchestras and conductors. Godoy frequently teaches workshops throughout Brazil and abroad.

programme.title: Al Di Meola - Al Di Meola - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the artists performing here in 2019 is Al Di Meola. This pioneering guitarist blends world music, rock and jazz. His ongoing fascination for complex rhythmic syncopation, combined with provocative lyrical melodies and sophisticated harmony, has been at the heart of his music throughout a celebrated career. The Grammy Award-winner has achieved international fame both as a solo artist and due to his collaborations with the world's biggest artists.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Albéniz - Iberia Book 1 And 2
programme.desc: On August 19, 2000, the Teatro Colón was filled to the brim with spectators longing to hear Daniel Barenboim play the piano. On the program: Ludwig van Beethoven's Sonata No. 23 ‘Apassionata’, Frederic Chopin's Waltz in e minor, and more.

programme.title: Maria Ana Bobone - Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone. After that, she continued her career with the release of ‘Nome de Mar’, which received many positive reviews. At the moment, Maria Ana is performing at all Portugal’s major venues, as well as many festivals and concert halls throughout the world, with the aim to present fado music and Portuguese culture to other cultures. Bobone’s latest album, ‘Fado And Piano’, shows her diversity as an artist, composer and arranger. By including the piano she re-innovates the tradition of the early 20th century. This portrait shows Maria Ana’s performances and interviews in which she explains her passion for fado music and culture.

programme.title: Sonya Lifschitz And Robert Davidson - Lifschitz And Davidson
programme.desc: Sonya Lifschitz is a pianist working across many contexts, with repertoire spanning from 15th century Faenza Codex to works written for her today. She is known for her fiercely imaginative, daring collaborations across film, animation, spoken word, visual and performance art. Robert Davidson has been making music from language since childhood. He has created music from the voices of Australia's prime ministers, from 100 years of radio broadcasts and from stories of asylum seekers and indigenous members of Australia's Stolen Generations. This performance is recorded during Classical:NEXT 2019 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson - Oscar Peterson - C Jam Blues
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk’s enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five, recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock And The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine’ some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Nina Simone - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sara Lucas, Daniela Serna, Maria Fernanda Gonzalez And Lara Klaus - Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Ladama, is a quintet of women multi-instrumentalists from Venezuela, Brazil, Colombia and the United States who not only perform as a touring band, but also strive to engage youth in their respective communities in the process of musicmaking, composition and audio production through collaboration and performance workshops. Ladama is a positive force in times urgently in need of tolerance and communication.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra And DR Big Band - Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl’s Best Friend’, from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things’ from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow’ from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River’ from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Muddy Waters - Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Raul Midón - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Hannu Lintu And Fins Radio Symfonie Orkest - Sibelius - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy. His many concerts with the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra in 2012 made him the obvious replacement for Sakari Oramo, who, after many years as conductor and concert master, terminated his contract in 2012. The orchestra specializes in the performance of Finnish music, but also performs the great masterpieces of Gustav Mahler and Béla Bartók. The Finnish composer Jean Sibelius is the orchestra’s favourite, as well as the conductor. In cooperation with Finland’s national public broadcasting company Yle, all seven Sibelius symphonies are recorded and broadcast. After a brief spoken introduction about the piece, the orchestra performs the complete symphony. After Sibelius was diagnosed with throat cancer in 1908, he changed his lifestyle as well as his approach to composition. Fearing death, he quit using alcohol and tobacco. Simultaneously, the harmonies in his works grew darker and more sombre. Devils and death are among the images conjured up by the gloomy sounds of this Symphony.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals. Their December 2010 performance with former backing musicians of Afrobeat founder Fela Kuti in Paris saw them hailed as the future of Afrobeat.

programme.title: Les McCann - Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today’s broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann’s vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including “Just Like Magic”, backed by his wonderful “Magic Band” of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Anna Muller And Paul Wallner - HVOB
programme.desc: The two musicians behind HVOB are Anna Müller and Paul Wallner. Anna Müller composes, produces, and provides the captivating, hypnotic vocals. The final production of the tracks is done in collaboration with Paul Wallner in his Vienna studio. HVOB are carving their path not just with their distinctive sound but with their live performances as well. The duo always plays live and performs with a drummer – a concept as innovative as it is successful: HVOB has just been voted number two best live act by the most influential German electronic music magazine De:bug.” Enjoy their 2019 show at Trabendo Paris!

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Lucerne Festival Orchestra And Magdalena Kožená - Abbado conducts Mahler No. 4 and Rückert-Lieder
programme.desc: Mezzo soprano Magdalena Kožená does not only make the heavenly joys resound in the final movement of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4, earlier in the concert, she devotes herself to the seraphic beauty and intimate simplicity of Mahler’s Rückert Lieder. Practically all songs that Mahler composed prior to 1900 were based on texts from Des Knaben Wunderhorn, a collection of folk poems published by Clemens Brentano and Achim von Arnim. Since then, Mahler turned exclusively towards one single poet, the Franconian orientalist and translator Friedrich Rückert. Mahler acknowledged that the poems moved him so deeply that he sometimes felt he had written them himself. In the transcendent final Lied, Ich bin der Welt abhanden gekommen, he also quoted a phrase from the Adagio of his fourth symphony. Asked what it meant, he replied that it personifies himself.

programme.title: Magic Slim, John McDonals, Andre Howard And Brian Jones - Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Matthew Dear - Matthew Dear
programme.desc: Matthew Dear is a shapeshifter, oscillating seamlessly between DJ, dance-music producer, and experimental pop auteur. He writes, produces, and mixes all of his work. He maintains four aliases (Audion, False, Jabberjaw, and Matthew Dear), each with its own style and distinct visual identity. He straddles multiple musical worlds and belongs to none, now nearly 20 years into his kaleidoscopic career, with five albums and two dozen EPs plus millions of miles in the rearview of his biography. Bunny, his fifth full-length released October 2018, parades down a rabbit hole of unhinged phrasings, dreams, and interludes. Bunny further confirms that Matthew Dear occupies a rarified corner of the musical universe: no longer tethered to any one genre, respected by his peers, and blessed with a bottomless well of creative energy. Enjoy his 2019 show at Trabendo Paris!

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. His Fantasie in C, Op. 17, was written in 1836. It was revised prior to publication in 1839 and dedicated to Franz Liszt. It is one of Schumann's greatest works for solo piano and a central work of the early Romantic period.

programme.title: Ivan Gomes And Lucibela Freitas Dos Santos - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world.
